t_advice_summary_textbox.text: it all depends on the colour of the gnomes ans which pairs they come in. They lead to two different forests one with a bright sky and one dark. The shape and style of the gnome doesnt matter.

vb_textbox.text: I don't think there is much connection between the colours of the gnomes. Sometimes I thought that the pink, brown and red gnomes took you to the forest withe the most mushrooms, but I think this changed as I progressed through the game. Go with your gut intincts, but beware the gnomes vary with regards to how many mushrooms you get from the forest.
